name: Melatia: With Love from Lumon
source:
The planet Lumon is being threatened with war. Many of its people have chosen to seek refuge on nearby planets, with one in particular going the extra mile to come all the way to Earth.

Meet Melatia; she's short in stature, has a mess of white hair on her head, and can hear your every thought. She's moved onto your roof and doesn't seem to be leaving any time soon.

Will you be able to help this alien refugee find her place on Earth? Your choices will greatly impact her future!

[From [url=https://frentzpatrick.itch.io/melatia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卢蒙星球正受到战争的威胁。许多人选择在附近的行星上寻求庇护，其中有一个人不遗余力地来到地球。

认识梅拉蒂亚；她身材矮小，头上有一头乱糟糟的白发，能听到你的每一个想法。她搬到了你的屋顶，而且似乎不会很快离开。

你能帮助这位外星难民在地球上找到自己的位置吗？你的选择将极大地影响她的未来！

[来自[url=https://frentzpatrick.itch.io/melatia]Itch.io[/url]]
